fusions.name: Hot Foot
fusions.desc: A kick of a red-hot spur that deals 11 damage and sets the target [Burning] for 2 damage a second for 4 seconds; your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. Your movement speed rises by 15% for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Daybreak Crow
fusions.desc: Crows the dawn in a ring of heat that deals 28 damage to every enemy within 3.5 tiles. If it hits, every ally strikes 20% harder for 15 seconds.

fusions.name: Brooding Warmth
fusions.desc: Restores 3 health a second to the ally who needs it most, for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Short Fuse
fusions.desc: When anything but fire hurts you, your physical damage rises by 20% for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds. You carry 10% fire resistance.
